translations.web: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
translations.bsb: Woe to you! For you build tombs for the prophets, but it was your fathers who killed them.
translations.kjv: Woe unto you! for ye build the sepulchres of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.
